citation: Aavang, Tjalk-Bøggild, Iolov, Rizzi, Zhang & Bjerva (2026), ACL 2026 Industry Track, pp. 1434-1460
text_source: Earnings call transcripts (Financial Modeling Prep) and 10-K/10-Q of 20 S&P 500 firms, 2023-2024; SECB 41K entries, ECB 10,477 chunks, ECB-A 587 annotated chunks. Licence: MIT on the Hugging Face card; none stated in the paper
feature: KPI tuples: KPI, value, scope, temporal context, modality (modality marks guidance and projections; not counted or scored separately)
method: Gold by one domain expert in two passes three months apart, no retest statistic; SEC gold from XBRL tags plus regex pseudo-tags; few-shot LLMs against SEC-trained BERT taggers; value-aligned matching with 1% tolerance
outcome: Best LLM (Gemini 3 Pro): Exact F1 11.5%, Semantic F1 61.6%, judge 45.5%; SEC-trained encoders Exact F1 0.0; pipeline precision 79.67% (478/600) by three evaluators, Krippendorff alpha 0.429; 18-32% of sampled unmatched predictions were valid items the annotator missed
pit_handling: Not handled; authors say the data is most likely in some models' training data
informs_decision: Gold checked by one human: precedent, with a warning (partial gold). Sub-task 1: tuple schema and scoring rule reusable. Guidance-revision hypothesis: not refuted

citation: Ju, Huang, Lin, Lin & Wang (2023), ACL 2023 Long Papers, pp. 14307-14321
text_source: 10-K Item 7 (MD&A), 2011-2018, 200 firms sampled from 3,849 with all eight years (survivors only); FINAL: 30,000 pseudo-labelled and 400 human-labelled segment pairs from consecutive years. Licence: none stated
feature: Word-level highlights of what changed between a prior-year and a current-year segment; pair type (insignificant, revised, mismatched)
method: Pair type by rule (ROUGE-2 at 0.6296 and Sentence-BERT cosine at 0.9011); training labels by rule (changed words are positive); evaluation labels by three graduate-student annotators, Fleiss kappa 0.71 (revised) and 0.60 (mismatched)
outcome: Domain-adapted BERT: R-Prec 0.7865, PCC 0.7290; zero-shot 0.7469 and 0.6067; rule labels alone 0.6968 and 0.6368
pit_handling: Not addressed (BERT-base; no LLM; no market outcome)
informs_decision: Unit of analysis (passage pairs from consecutive documents): supported. Rule-computed labels: partly supported, need a human check. Guidance-revision hypothesis: not refuted (annual MD&A, no change class, no guidance)

citation: Jiang, Liu, Cao, He, Xu, Xu, Deng, Tiwari, Chen, Lopez-Lira, Huang, Tsujii & Ananiadou (2026), arXiv 2601.04160v3 (RFC-BENCH)
text_source: Yahoo Finance news (title and summary), 1,404 articles on 223 stocks, April-December 2025; 1,826 original-perturbed pairs. Licence: MIT on the Hugging Face card; original article text not redistributed
feature: Minimal-pair perturbations: numerical 703, directional 532, causal 338, sentiment 253
method: GPT-4.1 rewrites under invariance constraints; full review by one expert, stratified audit by a second (pass 96.4/96.1/93.2/80.9%), two annotators (validity kappa 0.720; numerical 0.855, sentiment 0.686); about 11% of items removed
outcome: Single paragraph: accuracy 45.2-53.6% across 14 models, MCC near zero. Paired: GPT-4.1 96.9%, Qwen2.5-72B 92.1%, LLaMA 3.1-8B 57.5% with 886 invalid outputs
pit_handling: Not addressed; collection window stated but not related to model cutoffs
informs_decision: Sub-task 3 (minimal pairs): supported, with a construction recipe; wording-only edits need more human checking than numeric ones; present pair members separately. One-human check: below this paper's convention

citation: Bigeard, Nashold, Krishnan & Wu (2025), arXiv 2508.00828v1 (Finance Agent Benchmark)
text_source: SEC EDGAR filings published no earlier than 2024; 537 expert-written questions in nine categories. Licence: CC BY 4.0 for the 50 public questions; 150 on request; 337 private; harness MIT
feature: Open-ended research questions; the Beat or Miss category (69 questions) compares management guidance with later actuals across sequential quarterly documents
method: Seven finance experts wrote question, answer, sources and solution steps; each question reviewed by a second expert; no agreement statistic; rubric checks graded by an LLM judge, not validated against humans
outcome: Best model (o3) 46.8% class-balanced accuracy at $3.79 per query; no model above 50%; 22 models; expert 16.8 minutes and $25.66 per question; per-category accuracy not reported in the text read
pit_handling: Documents from 2024 on, described as after most training cutoffs, plus a private test set; not tested
informs_decision: Guidance-revision hypothesis: closest public benchmark, not a refutation (guidance against actuals, open QA, 50 public items). Size 500-800: in line. Class-balanced accuracy and cost per query: conventions to adopt

citation: Jiang, Chen, Makri, Chen, Li, Maatouk, Tassiulas, Brenner, Xiang & Ying (2026), arXiv 2602.07294v3 (Fin-RATE)
text_source: 2,472 SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF 14A and others) of 43 companies, 2020-2025; 7,500 QA items. Licence: MIT on the Hugging Face card
feature: Three QA tracks of 2,500 each; the longitudinal track compares one company's 10-K and proxy sections across years; no guidance-revision items found in the text read
method: QA generated by DeepSeek-V3.2, filtered by two LLMs, then manual review (reviewer count and agreement not stated); graded by a three-model judge ensemble with 88.8-90.5% agreement with human ratings
outcome: Abstract: accuracy falls by 18.60% and 14.35% from single-document to longitudinal and cross-entity tasks; retrieval-augmented accuracy below 27%
informs_decision: Change between disclosures: annual and LLM-generated, so not a substitute. Guidance-revision hypothesis: not refuted. Labels: convention of LLM-generated gold with light human review

citation: Choi, Kim, Yu, Cha, Golkhou, Halperin, Papaioannou, Kim, Wang, Kwon, Kim, Lopez-Lira & Lee (2025), arXiv 2510.03195v5 (From Text to Alpha)
text_source: Earnings call transcripts of S&P 100 firms, 2010-2024, 5,615 firm-quarters (vendor not named). No data set released
feature: LLM-extracted metric labels in three buckets, one of them guidance, targets and other indicators; score for metrics that disappear relative to four quarters earlier
method: Gemini-2.5-Pro extraction; cosine similarity of text-embedding-3-large vectors; no gold labels, no annotators, no extraction precision or recall
outcome: Q5-Q1 five-factor alpha -0.52% (t = -2.55) against -0.14% (t = -0.70) for the NER baseline; Fama-MacBeth coefficient t = -0.95
horizon: Portfolio returns; horizon not checked here
informs_decision: Guidance-revision hypothesis: not refuted (guidance is a bucket, no direction label, no gold). Belongs mainly to the stream on LLMs extracting financial signals

text_source: 10-K MD&A sentences and earnings call sentences of two companies (Mativ, 3M), train 2020-2021 and test 2022-2024; 1,490 labelled sentences. Licence: none stated; data on GitHub
feature: Sentence-level stance (positive, negative, neutral) toward debt, EPS and sales
method: Labels assigned by ChatGPT-o3-pro; humans checked the model's justifications for one company's call sentences (over 97% agreement); annotator count and sample not stated
outcome: Mean accuracy: GPT-4.1-mini 87.79%, Llama 3.3 70B 83.02%, Gemma 3 81.21%, Mistral Small 68.6%
incremental_to: Zero-shot against few-shot and chain-of-thought prompts
pit_handling: Not addressed; labeller and best evaluated model come from the same vendor
informs_decision: Gold labels: an example of LLM-assigned gold with thin human validation, the pattern our rule-computed labels are meant to avoid. Guidance-revision hypothesis: not refuted

citation: Islam, Kannappan, Kiela, Qian, Scherrer & Vidgen (2023), arXiv 2311.11944 (FinanceBench)
text_source: Filings of publicly traded companies; 10,231 questions with answers and evidence, of which 150 are public. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 on the Hugging Face card
feature: Open-book question answering over company filings
method: Questions with answers and evidence strings; construction not read (abstract only); 2,400 model answers reviewed by hand
outcome: GPT-4-Turbo with retrieval answered incorrectly or refused on 81% of the 150-question sample; 16 model configurations
informs_decision: Guidance-revision hypothesis: not refuted (no guidance or cross-period label in the abstract). Reuse is limited: 150 of 10,231 items are public

citation: Xie, Han, Chen, Xiang, Zhang, He and 28 others (2024), arXiv 2402.12659v2 (FinBen)
text_source: 36 existing data sets across 24 tasks (news, filings, calls, tabular data), including FinQA, ECTSum and FiNER-ORD. Licences vary by data set (MIT to CC BY-NC-ND; several listed only as public)
feature: Umbrella benchmark: extraction, text analysis, QA, summarisation, risk, forecasting, trading
method: Aggregates published data sets; three new ones
outcome: No task on guidance, on guidance revision, on comparing consecutive filings, or on minimal pairs
informs_decision: Guidance-revision hypothesis: supported for the most widely used umbrella benchmark

citation: Zhou, Ma & Liu (2021), Findings of ACL-IJCNLP 2021, pp. 2114-2124 (EDT); arXiv 2105.12825 read
text_source: Press-wire articles (PRNewswire, Businesswire, GlobeNewswire); 9,721 articles with token-level event labels and 303,893 with price labels. Licence: none stated; data on Google Drive
feature: Eleven corporate event types, one of them Guidance Increase (99 articles); no decrease, maintain or withdrawal class; periodic events excluded
method: Two annotators marked event spans independently and resolved disagreements by discussion; no agreement statistic
outcome: No detection F1 reported; Guidance Increase trades: 55.9% win rate, 0.88% mean one-day return, 282 trades
pit_handling: Not relevant (pre-LLM); trading test assumes zero latency
informs_decision: Guidance-revision hypothesis: the only public direction label found, one-sided and small, so not a refutation

citation: Shah, Hiray, Shah, Banerjee, Singh, Eidnani, Chava, Chaudhury & Chava (2024), arXiv 2402.11728v2 (Numerical Claim Detection in Finance)
text_source: Zacks analyst reports 2017-2020 (not released) and earnings calls of 78 NASDAQ-100 firms, 2017 to March 2023, 1,085 transcripts from investor-relations pages. Licence: CC BY 4.0 for the earnings-call part
feature: Numeric sentence is in-claim (a forecast) or out-of-claim (a stated past fact)
method: Gold by two authors with finance backgrounds, disagreements resolved by an expert; agreement 99.21% (reports) and 95.78% (calls); training labels from seventeen rule-based labelling functions
outcome: Weak-supervision F1 0.9272 (reports) and 0.9382 (calls); zero-shot ChatGPT-3.5 0.7569 on calls
informs_decision: Sub-task 1: reusable pre-filter and baseline for finding forward-looking numeric sentences. Rule-computed labels: supported (rules reach F1 above 0.92 against human gold)

text_source: 10-K XBRL financial statements of 43 S&P 500 companies; binary metrics on a 105-instance subset (43 clean, 62 error-injected). Licence: not stated on the abstract page
feature: Is a set of statements numerically consistent; four injected error types (arithmetic, cross-statement, year-over-year, magnitude)
method: Labels by controlled error injection into real statements; abstract only read
outcome: Nine of fourteen complete LLM runs gave 95-100% false positives on clean statements; recall 79.0% on rounded against 100.0% on unrounded rendering for one calibrated model
informs_decision: Sub-task 3: labels by construction are an accepted method; unedited controls and a false-positive rate are required; rendering of numbers moves the result
